events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. The legendary Woodstock festival truly defined a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll today. It's 49 years since Elvis Presley left the building, but his music continues to define generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas at the age of 25, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years ago today, the music world lost an icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the guitar virtuoso, Jimi Hendrix, who left us 56 years ago today. His innovative sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Abbey Road
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic album cover, those timeless tracks – pure genius. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and those iconic vocals. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: Original iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever with the original device. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's Global James Bond Day! Which Bond actor is your favourite, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's 86th
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Double album, double the genius. What's your standout track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The world remembers legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's voice and legacy are truly immortal.
